FAIZ SAYED 
Trade Settlement | Trade Support | Trade Operations Professional 
Mumbai, India | +91 9769457217 | faizsayed9786@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/faizsayed-ib17 
 
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY 
 
Investment Banking Operations professional with hands-on experience managing the end-to-end securities settlement lifecycle across 
Equity asset classes. Proven ability to ensure trades settle on contractual settlement date, maintain books and records accur acy, and 
resolve fails through root-cause analysis and counterparty liaison. Experienced in Delivery vs. Payment (DVP) settlement, Receive vs 
payment (RVP) nostro/securities reconciliation, SSI management, and STP enhancement. Adept at cross-functional collaboration with 
front office, custodians, and clearinghouses, with exposure to DTCC/DTC, Euroclear and international market settlement. Certi fied 
Investment Banking Operations Professional with a strong foundation in operational risk management and process improvement.  
 
WORK EXPERIENCE 
Associate – Wealth Management Operations — BNP Paribas, Mumbai Feb 2023 – Jul 2026 
Settlement & Trade Processing 
• Managed end-to-end settlement lifecycle for Equity and Mutual Fund transactions, ensuring all trades settled on contractual 
settlement date (T+2) in line with trade details booked in the firm's system. 
• Coordinated DVP/RVP settlement obligations with global custodians and clearinghouses, monitoring and resolving trade 
discrepancies to prevent settlement failures. 
• Ensured accurate and timely trade capture for both bank and client positions, maintaining data integrity and 75%+ STP rates across 
high-volume portfolios. 
• Processed, matched, and verified equity and mutual fund trade confirmations against daily blotters and inputs from Relationship 
Managers/Asset Managers. 
Fail & Reconciliation Management 
• Spearheaded fail trade management by conducting root-cause analysis on settlement hurdles, optimizing Standing Settlement 
Instructions (SSIs), and aggressively liaising with counterparties — achieving a 90% reduction in aged fails and significantly 
reducing buy-in risk. 
• Monitored and resolved nostro and securities reconciliation breaks, ensuring firm books and records were aligned with external 
custodian and depository records. 
• Maintained a late/failed trade report, updating reasons for fails and escalating unresolved items to senior management in a timely 
manner. 
Controls, Risk & Process Improvement 
• Contributed to the firm's operational control environment by identifying settlement risk exposures and implementing mitigating 
measures, balancing risk with commercial objectives. 
• Collaborated with front office, compliance, and technology teams to enhance client service levels and support new business 
development initiatives. 
• Identified and implemented process improvements to increase settlement efficiency, reduce manual intervention, and enhance STP 
rates across the settlement workflow. 
 
PROJECTS 
DPM Client Category Module | BNP Paribas 
• Led end-to-end UAT for client segmentation module; served as final sign-off authority for QA and successfully transitioned the 
module from testing to production with zero post-launch defects. 
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to align category definitions with business requirements, improving accuracy of client 
data classification. 
Trade Auto-Execution Enhancement | BNP Paribas 
• Analyzed existing auto-execution workflows and identified optimization opportunities, contributing to improved STP rates and 
reduced manual intervention in the settlement process. 
• Partnered with technology and operations teams to implement solutions, deepening understanding of automated trade processing 
and settlement controls. 
KEY SKILLS 
Settlement & Operations 
• Securities Settlement: End-to-end settlement lifecycle management for Equity; contractual settlement date adherence; DVP/RVP; 
T+2/T+1 regulatory cycles 
• Fail Management: Root-cause analysis, aged fail resolution, buy-in risk mitigation, counterparty liaison 
• Books & Records: Nostro and securities reconciliation; ensuring internal system records agree with external custodian and 
depository records 
• FOP Transfers: Free of Payment securities transfers; bank-to-bank/custodian-to-custodian transfer processing; settlement 
instruction validation and exception resolution 
• SWIFT: Hands-on exposure to MT540 / MT542 securities settlement messages, instruction processing and settlement 
follow-up 
• Asset Classes: Equities, Mutual Funds 
Market & System Knowledge 
• Depositories & Clearinghouses: DTC/DTCC, Euroclear, international markets 
• Settlement Platforms: Olympic, Swift messaging, Neolink. 
• Matching & Confirmation: Trade confirmation matching, DTCC Trade Suite 
Controls & Process 
• Operational Risk: Control environment design, risk identification, mitigation, and audit readiness 
• Process Improvement: STP enhancement, workflow analysis, automation initiatives, exception reduction 
• Vendor & Stakeholder Management: Cross-functional collaboration with front office, custodians, compliance, and technology 
teams 
• Regulatory Awareness: T+1/T+2 settlement rules, CSDR, internal compliance protocols, fail penalty awareness
